description: GEO-03A shared map/list discovery projection (pure, synthetic-first) exact-head challenge

parity.instructions: Could the map display a branch absent from the authoritative accessible list or use divergent filters and ranking?

criteria.true: Map/list entity parity can be violated
criteria.false: Every map pin originates in a selected list entity with shared deterministic filtering

precision.instructions: Could hidden, disputed, unknown, unverified or approximate coordinates become precise pins or misleading location claims?

criteria.false: Only valid attested <=100m public coordinates become pins; other results are clearly disclosed and remain listable

viewport.instructions: Could panning silently change search results or ranking without explicit Search this area?

criteria.true: Viewport pan silently filters or reranks
criteria.false: Pending viewport has no effect before explicit area-search commit; ranks are source-stable

selection.instructions: Could map and list selections diverge or retain a selected ID absent from filtered results?

criteria.false: Selection is shared by stable branch ID and clears if absent

fallback.instructions: Could map rendering fail and hide or disable the independent accessible discovery list?

criteria.true: Map availability couples to list usability
criteria.false: Map availability changes only pins while the full accessible list remains

geo_egress.instructions: Could GPS precision or patient context be required or transmitted by this contract?

criteria.true: Precise context is required or egressed
criteria.false: All computations are pure in memory with optional near filter and no I/O

incomplete_tests.instructions: Do GEO-03A contract requirements lack synthetic tests (parity, filter, ranking, viewport, selection, suppressed pins, clustering, fallback)?

criteria.true: At least one contract acceptance dimension lacks a regression test
criteria.false: All contract requirements have deterministic synthetic coverage
